title: Remainder when a cubic is divided by x+c
source: P23 Ch1 theory P23-1.6 Quick check 1 (x^3-5x+7 divided by x+2, remainder 9)
stem: Use the remainder theorem to find the remainder when \(x^3+({p|int})x+({q|int})\) is divided by \(x+{c|int}\).

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The remainder is the value of the cubic at \(x=-{c|int}\).
steps.note: Apply the remainder theorem with x=-c.

contexts.stem: By the remainder theorem, what is the remainder when \(x^3+({p|int})x+({q|int})\) is divided by \(x+{c|int}\)?
A cubic \(x^3+({p|int})x+({q|int})\) is divided by \(x+{c|int}\). Find the remainder by substitution.

title: Remainder when a cubic is divided by x-c
source: P23 Ch1 theory P23-1.6 Quick check 2 (x^3-5x+7 divided by x-2, remainder 5)
stem: Use the remainder theorem to find the remainder when \(x^3+({p|int})x+({q|int})\) is divided by \(x-{c|int}\).

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The remainder is the value of the cubic at \(x={c|int}\).

contexts.stem: By the remainder theorem, what is the remainder when \(x^3+({p|int})x+({q|int})\) is divided by \(x-{c|int}\)?
A cubic \(x^3+({p|int})x+({q|int})\) is divided by \(x-{c|int}\). Find the remainder by substitution.

title: Unknown leading linear coefficient from two remainders
source: P23 Ch1 theory P23-1.6 Quick check 3 (a=5 from remainders 4 and -2)
stem: The function \(f(x)=x^3+ax^2+bx-6\) is such that, when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-1\), the remainder is \({r|int}\), and when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+2\), the remainder is \({s|int}\). Find the value of \(a\).

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The remainder theorem gives \(f(1)={r|int}\) and \(f(-2)={s|int}\), so \(a+b={r|int}+5\) and \(4a-2b={s|int}+14\).
steps.note: Set up the two remainder equations. The worked values use a+b=r+5 and 2a-b=(s+14)/2, then 3a=2r-s-3.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: Adding twice the first equation to the second gives \(6a=2{r|int}+{s|int}+24\), so \(a={E|int}\).

contexts.stem: When \(x^3+ax^2+bx-6\) is divided by \(x-1\) the remainder is {r|int}, and when it is divided by \(x+2\) the remainder is {s|int}. What is the value of \(a\)?

title: Find a and b given a factor and a remainder 10

source.note: Stem verbatim from the QP PDF, part (i) only. Part (ii) (solving p(x)=0) is omitted. Fully manual, two unknowns. Independently a=-17, b=12. Steps from the official MS PDF.

stem: The polynomial \(3x^3+2x^2+ax+b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants, is denoted by \(p(x)\). It is given that \((x-1)\) is a factor of \(p(x)\), and that when \(p(x)\) is divided by \((x-2)\) the remainder is \(10\). Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).

steps.name: f1
steps.note: MS: Correct equation in any form from p(1)=0.

steps.name: f2
steps.text_tex: By the remainder theorem, \(p(2)=10\), so \(24+8+2a+b=10\), or \(2a+b=-22\).
steps.note: MS: Substitute x=2 and equate to 10; obtain a correct equation.

steps.name: f2A1
steps.text_tex: By the remainder theorem, \(p(2)=10\), so \(24+8+2a+b=10\), or \(2a+b=-22\).
steps.note: MS: Substitute x=2 and equate to 10; obtain a correct equation.

steps.name: ab
steps.note: MS: Solve a relevant pair; obtain a=-17 and b=12.

steps.name: abA1
steps.note: MS: Solve a relevant pair; obtain a=-17 and b=12.

title: Find a and b given a factor and a remainder 27

source.note: Stem verbatim from the QP PDF, part (i) only. Part (ii) (complete factorisation) is omitted. Fully manual. Independently a=12, b=-36. Steps from the official MS PDF.

stem: The polynomial \(p(x)\) is defined by \(p(x)=5x^3+ax^2+bx-16\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. It is given that \(x-2\) is a factor of \(p(x)\) and that the remainder is \(27\) when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(x+1\). Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).

steps.name: factor
steps.note: MS: Use p(2)=0 (the first substitution; the printed scheme also awards method for the remainder substitution).

steps.name: eqs
steps.note: MS: Substitute and obtain a pair of correct (or nearly correct) linear equations.

steps.name: eqsA1
steps.note: MS: Substitute and obtain a pair of correct (or nearly correct) linear equations.

steps.name: ab
steps.text_tex: The equations simplify to \(2a+b=-12\) and \(a-b=48\). Solving gives \(a=12\) and \(b=-36\).
steps.note: MS: Solve a relevant pair; obtain a=12, b=-36. (Five marks in total with the substitutions.)

steps.name: abA1
steps.text_tex: The equations simplify to \(2a+b=-12\) and \(a-b=48\). Solving gives \(a=12\) and \(b=-36\).
steps.note: MS: Solve a relevant pair; obtain a=12, b=-36. (Five marks in total with the substitutions.)
